content: Alcohol Use Disorder, or AUD, is a health condition that can cause intense cravings, a compulsion to drink, and a lack of control – even if that means negative consequences such as losing personal, family, and work connections. People may also refer to Alcohol Use Disorder as alcoholism or problem drinking.  It is diagnosed by a health professional, and can be mild, moderate, or severe. The good news is that AUD is entirely treatable, and a full recovery is possible for just about everyone.
